# Neo Trading — Auto Imports from Japan
> Premier Japanese Used Car Exporter & Direct Auction Agent based in Tokyo, Japan.

Website: https://neojapancars.com/
Contact: neollcjp@gmail.com | +81-80-9718-5080
Headquarters: Neo LLC, Higashikomatsugawa 1-12-1, Edogawa, Tokyo, Japan

## What We Do
Neo Trading Co., Ltd specializes in direct **auto imports from Japan** for individual buyers, car collectors, dealerships, and commercial fleets worldwide. We provide direct access to over 150+ Japanese auto auction halls (USS, TAA, CAA, JU, etc.) and vetted Japanese dealer inventory.

## Core Capabilities
- **Direct Japanese Auction Sourcing**: Over 100,000+ vehicles available weekly. We translate official Japanese auction inspection sheets and bid on your behalf.
- **Physical Stock Inventory**: Verified Japanese used cars ready for immediate export.
- **Pre-Shipment Inspections**: Full mechanical inspections and certification (JEVIC, JAAI, EAA, QISJ) according to destination country standards.
- **Documentation & Deregistration**: Official Japanese Export Certificate with English translation, original Bill of Lading, and commercial invoice.
- **Worldwide Shipping**: RoRo (Roll-on/Roll-off) and Container ocean freight to North America, Europe, Australia, New Zealand, East & Southern Africa, and the Caribbean.

## Key Pages & Resources
- [Stock Inventory](https://neojapancars.com/stock-cars): Ready-to-export Japanese used vehicles with FOB pricing.
- [Auction Sourcing](https://neojapancars.com/auctions): How to buy vehicles directly from live Japanese auctions.
- [JDM & Auto Import Blog](https://neojapancars.com/blog): In-depth market guides on importing Japanese cars to the US & UK.
  - [US 25-Year Rule Guide](https://neojapancars.com/blog/importing-jdm-cars-to-usa-25-year-rule): NHTSA HS-7 & EPA 3520-1 forms, 2.5% duty, state titling.
  - [UK Import Guide](https://neojapancars.com/blog/how-to-import-cars-from-japan-to-uk): IVA test, 10-year rule, HMRC NOVA, DVLA V55/5 registration.
  - [Top 10 JDM Cars to Import](https://neojapancars.com/blog/top-10-jdm-cars-to-import-from-japan): Skyline GT-R, Supra, RX-7, Kei trucks, specs & values.
  - [Japanese Car Auctions Guide](https://neojapancars.com/blog/japanese-car-auctions-guide-usa-uk-buyers): USS & TAA bidding, sheet translations.
- [Auto Import Guide & Resources](https://neojapancars.com/resources): Comprehensive guides on import regulations, FOB vs CIF pricing, auction sheet grading, and shipping.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://neojapancars.com/faq): Answers to payment methods, shipping durations, country rules, and paperwork.
- [Vehicle Inquiry & Custom Sourcing](https://neojapancars.com/inquiry): Request a personalized CIF quote to your destination port.

## Popular Vehicle Categories
- **JDM Sports & Collector Cars**: Nissan Skyline GT-R (R32, R33, R34), Mazda RX-7 (FD3S), Toyota Supra (JZA80), Subaru Impreza WRX STI, Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution.
- **Kei Trucks & Vans (4WD)**: Daihatsu Hijet, Suzuki Carry, Subaru Sambar, Honda Acty.
- **SUVs & Off-Roaders**: Toyota Land Cruiser, Land Cruiser Prado, Hilux Surf, Suzuki Jimny, Nissan Safari/Patrol.
- **Commercial & Passenger**: Toyota HiAce vans, Toyota Alphard / Vellfire, hybrid cars (Prius, Aqua).
